paper_metadata.title: Microstructures and mechanical properties of Ta–Nb–Zr–Ti–Al refractory high entropy alloys with varying Ta/Ti ratios

evidence.quote: The refractory high entropy alloys (RHEAs) containing disordered body-centered cubic (BCC) and ordered BCC (B2) structures often exhibit high strength but low ductility at room temperature, even in the compressive tests.
Microstructures and mechanical properties of Ta–Nb–Zr–Ti–Al refractory high entropy alloys with…
In this study, (Ta25-xNb25Zr25Ti25+x)95Al5 (x = 0, 5, 10) RHEAs are fabricated to investigate the compositional dependence of the microstructures and mechanical properties.

The alloys with three designed compositions, (Ta25-xNb25Zr25Ti25+x)95Al5 (x = 0, 5, 10), were fabricated, and are denoted in short as Ta25Ti25, Ta20Ti30, and Ta15Ti35 in the following text, respectively.

The alloys with three designed compositions, (Ta25-xNb25Zr25Ti25+x)95Al5 (x = 0, 5, 10), were fabricated, and are denoted in short as Ta25Ti25, Ta20Ti30, and Ta15Ti35 in the following text, respectively.

The alloys with three designed compositions, (Ta25-xNb25Zr25Ti25+x)95Al5 (x = 0, 5, 10), were fabricated, and are denoted in short as Ta25Ti25, Ta20Ti30, and Ta15Ti35 in the following text, respectively.

other.re-melting: flipped and re-melted at least six times with electromagnetic stirring

evidence.quote: The Ta, Nb, Zr, Ti, and Al elemental metals with the purity of > 99.9% were used as raw materials, which were mixed by arc melting in the Ti-gettered high purity argon atmosphere. The as-cast ingots were flipped and re-melted at least six times with electromagnetic stirring, to enhance chemical homogeneity.

parameters.atmosphere: sealed in evacuated argon-backfilled quartz tubes

evidence.quote: The as-cast alloys were solution-treated (ST) at 1300 °C for 24 h, followed by water quenching, and denoted as ST-1300/24 in the following text.

The alloys were then aged at 600 °C for 6, 12, and 24 h, which were depicted as 600–6, 600–12, and 600–24, respectively. During the heat treatment, all samples were wrapped in a Ta foil, and were sealed in the evacuated argon-backfilled quartz tubes.
